methods.label: Oct 14, 2026
methods.title: New team model: TORQUE replaces Team GRAVITY for The 30
methods.text: The 30 now ranks teams with TORQUE, a new team model, and lives on its own page. The July method added up player projections weighted by last season's minutes; it ignored rookies and returnees and squeezed every player's minutes equally on deep rosters. TORQUE prices every player and hands out minutes like a real rotation. Tested on 2011–2026 seasons it was never tuned on, it ordered the standings at 0.736 against 0.700 for the July method: a real but modest gain. The July 2026 edition stays published unchanged, and forecast E1 is graded on it as registered.
